reviewed_boundary.scope:
1. Scope and Applicability

Manufacture of complete new diesel single-chamber rear-loading refuse compactor road vehicles, with a purchased runnable cab-chassis, fabricated steel body/subframe and hydraulic packing/discharge equipment integrated and accepted by the vehicle converter. Declare one exact VIN/model and released body/chassis configuration. This is a narrower product and manufacturing-route boundary within CPC49119, not every special-purpose vehicle.

Exclude body-only, chassis-only, rebuilt/remanufactured vehicles, multi-chamber and side/front-load architectures, electric/CNG propulsion, street sweepers, fire engines, mobile cranes, concrete mixers, ambulances and ordinary goods vehicles. Waste collection/transport/treatment service, transported waste mass, driver/crew/payload, operation, maintenance, distribution and end-of-life are outside scope. Factory functional/road tests and rework are manufacturing. No service life, collection yield or waste-throughput denominator is assumed.

evidence_limitations: Heil2025-labelled brochure case supports welded steel/subframe, actuation/controls and chassis interfaces; no thickness, weight, capacity, pressure, flow, cycle time, life, supplier activity or emission factor adopted. Specifications are subject to change.
Independent Dennis Eagle Olympus manufacturer single-compartment/lift/hydraulic-ram architecture; undated product page, no numerical LCI or universal test requirements adopted.

Scania attachment tables have no printed edition and metadata modified October2021; historical interface alternatives only, no current installation approval, part availability or universal fastener size/grade/torque.

Complete-vehicle UUID is a publicly verified manufactured CPC49119 product with Mass reference, qualified by exact diesel single-chamber rear-loader configuration. It does not supply a generic mix, supplier LCI or methodology approval.

Conditional formulations/components and emissions require actual released BOM/SDS/supplier and calibrated foreground evidence. No uniform machine mass, exhaust or leakage assumed. Unresolved individual identities remain explicit and block unsupported identity claims.
Manufacturing converter foreground only; complete cradle-to-gate requires independent supplier/transport/treatment coverage. Scientific review pending and Chinese aligned, not reviewed/published.
